headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 3, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Baltimore Orioles with an 8-0 shutout victory, led by Tim Mayza's strong outing from the bullpen. In other news, the Washington Nationals fell short in Atlanta, with Mike Yastrzemski leading the team in batting with 1 hit, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 5-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Jordan Walker leading the offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Mitch Keller of the Pittsburgh Pirates being placed on the 60-day injured list due to a right arm teres major muscle injury. Connor Seabold of the Kansas City Royals has also been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a right lat strain. Other teams have also reported injuries, including the Washington Nationals, Tampa Bay Rays, Toronto Blue Jays, San Francisco Giants, and Atlanta Braves.

The Kansas City Royals made a trade debut with new pitcher Carlos Duran, acquired in a trade with the Los Angeles Dodgers. The Dodgers sent LHP Kris Bubic to Kansas City in exchange for the right-handed pitcher. The Washington Nationals also made a trade, sending LHP Foster Griffin to the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for LHP Will Dion, LHP Josh Hartle, OF Nick Mitchell, and RHP Kendeglys Virguez.

top_news.title: **Phillies Shut Out Orioles 8-0**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing an 8-0 victory. Tim Mayza earned the win after a strong outing from the bullpen.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Atlanta**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals suffered a 2-4 loss to the Atlanta Braves, with Mike Yastrzemski leading the team in batting with 1 hit, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Didier Fuentes impressed on the mound with 2.0 innings pitched, 4 strikeouts, and 0 earned runs allowed.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Blue Jays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 5-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Jordan Walker leading the offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs. Matthew Liberatore pitched 6 strong innings, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 hit.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Fall to Guardians in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks suffered a 5-0 loss to the Cleveland Guardians, with Patrick Bailey leading the team's offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates' Mitch Keller Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates right-hander Mitch Keller has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a right arm teres major muscle injury. Keller's status change is the latest update for the Pirates.

top_news.title: **Royals Make Trade Debut with New Pitcher**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have welcomed Carlos Duran to the team, acquired in a trade with the Los Angeles Dodgers. Duran joins the Royals after the Dodgers sent LHP Kris Bubic to Kansas City in exchange for the right-handed pitcher.
